original_target.title: Global regularity of two-dimensional ideal incompressible MHD

scope_comparison: Current ideal/non-resistive MHD searches yielded damping, horizontal dissipation, positive viscosity, small perturbations and interface problems. These change either the two zero dissipation coefficients, whole-plane geometry or arbitrary-Schwartz-data condition. Hirata's criterion requires magnetic regularity along evolution and is not unconditional global continuation.
